buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='artifacts/calculator-platform/config/omni-inventory.json';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');let o='',q=false,e=false;for(const c of s){const n=c.charCodeAt(0);if(e){o+=c;e=false;continue}if(c==='\\'&&q){o+=c;e=true;continue}if(c==='\"'){o+=c;q=!q;continue}if(q&&n<32){if(c==='\n')o+='\\n';else if(c==='\r')o+='\\r';else if(c==='\t')o+='\\t';else o+='\\u'+n.toString(16).padStart(4,'0')}else o+=c}JSON.parse(o);fs.writeFileSync(p,o)" && node artifacts/calculator-platform/scripts/generate-omni-database.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/calculator-platform build
